coordinateConvention: PCB top view; origin at upper-left of maximum board-outline centerline bounding box, +X right, +Y down. Components face same direction and boards naturally coplanar, per user confirmation. All units mm.
scope: Read-only current source and actual exported Gerber/drill geometry. No CAD/PCB changes. Bottom component height and solder-tail projection remain physical-measurement inputs.

long.nominalShapeSummary: 54 mm maximum width × 80 mm height; central body x=3..51 mm, side protrusions to x=0/54 over y≈27..53 mm; four nominal R4 mm corners. Source has submicron arc/endpoint discrepancies, retain native Gerber centerline for exact traceability.

recommendedSupport.recommendationStatus: XY-compatible with actual copper/mask/paste and independent native body+pad / PTH zones expanded by 0.5 mm. Physical fit and Z tolerance remain required.
recommendedSupport.undersideVerticalClearance: PCB bottom must stand above the maximum underside component/solder-tail projection plus assembly tolerance; do not place a continuous flat support directly against the populated underside.

independentBottomBodyCrosscheck.method: Independent bottom-body extraction supplies current native layer48 body plus actual pad union bounding boxes; check the proposed 6 mm support against those boxes expanded by its explicit 0.5 mm XY allowance, plus top-component PTH tail/solder zones.

physicalThickness.evidence: User physical approximate measurement confirmed by parent; separate from current CAD layer-stack arithmetic.
